title: AutoShark (BSC) — L2 Phase 2 deep-dive: live funds are holder-owned; fresh-attacker extraction $0

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from AutoShark: the $146.9k of live DEX liquidity is LP owned by third parties (~97% of the top pair in one team EOA; the rest staked in the MasterOcean/MasterSquid farms or held in keeper/owner-gated fee vaults), every privileged payout path is role-gated, permissionless paths are empty or pay only unpriced zombie-token dust, FINS emissions are capped/zero, and jawsPool custodies nothing.
